title: Pose estimate stability, with the module held still

protocol.arm: held still, so all variation between estimates is the estimator

interpretation: Jitter is what a closed loop feels: the policy servos to the estimate every control step, so frame-to-frame movement is a disturbance at the control rate. Bias is what filtering cannot remove. A head with low bias and high jitter is a filtering problem; one with low jitter and high bias is a training problem.
